751-3755-4742.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1432-2645-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

151-5261-7329.easyPrerequisites:
Your deck size is 2 or greater.
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-5261-7329.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-5261-7329.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

225-2557-3129-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1315-3756-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

364-1809-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1809-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1809-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6968-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
3259-6968-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-2438-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2438-4321-7422.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

280-1558-3875-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-3875-4231-6753.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2308-2811-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-2811-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Elas il-Kor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Elas il-Kor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger from step 5, causing each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger from step 3, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4131-4893-7170.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Living Brain.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-4613-5802-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-4613-5802-7152.description:
Cast Verdant Touch with buyback by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-4613-5802-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Verdant Touch. Verdant Touch is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

654-4498-6712.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sonic triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that is dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasure(s).
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
654-4498-6712.notes: It is strongly recommended to perform this combo once you have the highest life total to end the game. It is, however, not a requirement.

1806-2034-4666-6867.description:
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Scourge and the Ally, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1806-2034-4666-6867.notes: You can forego sacrificing the Ally during an iteration if mana allows.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

3525-5479-6702--119.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
3525-5479-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.
3525-5479-6702--119.notes: This combo will also give you infinite results from whatever method you use to tap Kilo.

198-3767-3918-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
198-3767-3918-5396.notes: The mana cost is {0} if Trazyn has a charge counter on it.

2086-2919-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

2173-4423-4426-4693-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
2173-4423-4426-4693-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
2173-4423-4426-4693-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
2173-4423-4426-4693-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

147-2034-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

3182-3676-4365-5751--1.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3182-3676-4365-5751--1.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Tangleroot and Turntimber Sower trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Turntimber Sower trigger, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G}, sacrificing the {0} cost creature and sacrificing the two Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

804-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
804-5315-5365.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
804-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2741-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2741-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2292-2868-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2292-2868-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4.

1652-2136-4050-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
1652-2136-4050-5200.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Patron of the Arts with haste.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing the Patron of the Arts tokens, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens die, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control.

719-1951-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Speaker of the Heavens does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 47.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1951-2534.description:
Activate Speaker of the Heavens by tapping it, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying.
When the Angel enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Xenograft, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Speaker of the Heavens.
Repeat.

1633-1887-2060-4120-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

628-1887-2034-2122.notablePrerequisites: Mindless Automaton has an even number of +1/+1 counters on it.
628-1887-2034-2122.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 1 until Mindless Automaton has zero +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mindless Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Mindless Automaton dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of six +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2396-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Ophidian Eye attached to Brallin.
You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
2396-4703.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, getting a +1/+1 counter and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card for each damage dealt.
Pass priority, moving to an additional cleanup step.
Repeat until you have no cards left in library or have won the game.
